notes: The hit counter has a problem: the template's hit condition is `!(!rst_ni) && antecedent`. For this check the antecedent is `!rst_ni`, so that condition is never true and hits_CHK_008 stays 0. I kept the template line as given. To count real hits during reset, change that line to `if (!rst_ni) hits_CHK_008 <= hits_CHK_008 + 1;`. The falling-edge assertion has no hit counter. This avoids a second always_ff driving the same variable. Both assertions omit disable iff and use the antecedent !rst_ni, as the rules require for reset checks. No parameter-dependent quantities are used, so the code is identical in all four configurations.
